asset.name: Gepard 35 mm SPAA
asset.description:
Gepard 35 mm SPAA - Early WIP
An early playable Gepard project for Arma Reforger. Several functions are unfinished and improvements are planned.
Known limitations
Crew can still be injured or killed by fragments and nearby outside explosions. Crew protection is unfinished.
Independent destruction of the mounted default turret hit zone is temporarily disabled while the hull is alive. Hull, crew and other component damage remain active.
Radar deployment and sweep are cosmetic. Radar sensing, search and radar tracking are unavailable.
Ballistics, aiming correction and stabilization are unfinished. Armor and ballistic behaviour are not presented as a validated realistic simulation.
Multiplayer, join-in-progress, dedicated-server and console behaviour are not fully qualified.
Sounds currently use stock game assets.
Feedback and source
Bug reports and visual feedback: https://github.com/mortal414/gepard/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml
Release source: https://github.com/mortal414/gepard
Please include the game/mod version, steps to reproduce, other enabled mods and useful screenshots or logs. Remove private information before posting.
Development tools
Built with heavy use of OpenAI Codex and Reforger Agent Harness. The generic tools are available separately under Apache-2.0:
https://github.com/mortal414/reforger-agent-harness
Tooling feedback: https://github.com/mortal414/reforger-agent-harness/issues
Credits
Native game content remains under Bohemia Interactive’s terms. The limited Kiichi tracked-guide MIT notice is retained in the release source and package.
asset.summary: Early WIP Gepard self-propelled anti-aircraft vehicle with twin 35 mm guns.
asset.changelog:
Added optical stabilization with entity and position tracking, plus a confirmed entity-lock reticle cue.
Added independent C rangefinding and approximate ballistic elevation adjustment for left/right/both HEI-T feeds, with stabilization OFF or ON.
Integrated the accepted exterior detail batch: front guards/apron, tracking-head ribs, rear lamps/static cover, roof containers, rounded sight cases, radar-bay hood and regional side details.
Cleaned the production resource closure; retained development tests separately and preserved referenced inherited resources and WCS/SpaceCore dependencies.
